Investment has undrawn commitments. Unamortized fees are classified as unearned income which reduces cost basis, which may result in a negative cost basis. A negative fair value may result from the unfunded commitment being valued below par.

rationale: C103 flagged negative fair_value rows for review, but the raw schedule itself reports the negative fair values for sampled flagged delayed draw positions: Echo Purchaser fair value (189), PracticeTek fair value (16), and Petra Borrower fair value (12,422). The filing footnote explains that investments with undrawn commitments can have negative cost basis and that negative fair value may result from unfunded commitments being valued below par. The extracted negative fair values therefore match the source and are not data errors.
